newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila okays Orient Bank commercial bank status.
newsitem.headline: Manila okays Orient Bank commercial bank status.

text.p: The Philippine Monetary Board had approved the application of Orient Development Banking Corp (Orient Bank) for a commercial banking license, Central Bank deputy governor Edgardo Zialcita said on Monday.

Zialcita said in a statement it has approved the application of Orient Bank for a commercial banking license after the Gotesco group, through units Ever Electrical Manufacturing Inc and Go Tong Electrical Supply Co Inc, infused fresh capital into the bank.

Orient Bank, formerly Bangko Silangan Development Bank, ran into financial difficulties in 1993 and 1994, prompting the Sermonia group, which then controlled the bank, to sell 72 percent of its interest to the Gotesco group.
The bank currently has 28 branches and has authority from the Central Bank to open an additional 23 branches nationwide.
